entries.title: Diagram cardinality supplies an argument value to an adjacent whole

source_evidence.quote:
- The exact narrow spiral-band rendering is a real local subseries: three
  adjacent pages, all with eight curved text-bearing compartments.
- The broader eight-curved-compartment family contains five pages after adding
  two decorated petal-like predecessors.
- Curved compartments are not an eight-value key. A nearby page has twelve
  curved, text-bearing lobes around a central circle.
- Four other surfaces have a clear eightfold primary division rendered as
  straight sectors or interlaced circles.

entries.title: Caption and prose channels select different argument arity on one diagram page

source_evidence.quote:
Ashmole 399 supplies the strongest readable precedent so far for q13's mixed
page architecture, but not for its content or exact topology. A medieval
medical page can combine an abstract connected system, short inscriptions
owned by individual components, one embedded humanlike figure, and dense
longer practical text. Another abstract-system page in the same manuscript
uses predominantly continuous prose instead, showing that caption and prose
layouts can vary within one technical codex.

entries.title: A stable inner payload with changing outer wrapper marks a role operator

source_evidence.quote:
Two of the three all-reading-stable figure-associated labels share the same
renderer-stripped HPR2 payload as one of the six tube-state labels:

| figure label | tube label | shared payload | surface change |
|---|---|---|---|
| `dotedy` (`f77r.8`) | `otedy` (`f77r.3`) | `e|NONE|DY1|B30` | add outer `d` wrapper |
| `otchdy` (`f77r.49`) | `dchdy` (`f77r.6`) | `ch|NONE|DY1|B30` | `d` wrapper versus `OT` frame |

This is a coherent local compiler pattern: opaque payload can remain stable
while its left rendering changes with visual label class.

entries.near_predecessors: Near GDT198 and IDEA000035/039, but narrows the proposition to an explicit wrapper-to-role operation rather than payload reuse, instrument/endpoint, or component identity.

entries.title: Dry/moist whole pairs operate on a shared amount frame

source_evidence.quote:
cheor und sheor sind nun das beste kleine Inhaltsparadigma:

| Ganzwort | Mengenanschlüsse | globale exakte Vorkommen | Arbeitswert |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| cheor | 3 auf 3 Seiten | 56 | trockener Drogenteil |
| sheor | 3 auf 3 Seiten | 31 | feuchter Drogenteil |

Beide stehen in exakten Mengenplätzen, gemeinsam unter s, or und ar sowie bei
Wert II und III. Damit wird der Trocken/Feucht-Gegensatz praktisch nützlich:
Die Formen sind nicht nur abstrakte Zustandsfelder, sondern Kandidaten für
zähl- oder wägbare Drogenteile.
